copy.headline: The Elizabeth — a sculpted bra-top dress with an elongated skirt.
copy.description: The Elizabeth leads with its bodice: a brazer top cut close and confident, flowing into a long, unbroken skirt. The collection's most sculptural piece — ₦245,000 across UK 6–12.
copy.atelierNotes: Ready-to-wear piece produced in limited runs.
copy.editorialQuote: A bodice with opinions — the Elizabeth speaks first.

fabric.drapeDescription: Sculpted hold through the bodice, fluid skirt
fabric.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. Cool iron on reverse.
